name: Supabase
model: A Postgres database per project plus a platform: generated REST and GraphQL APIs, auth, file storage, realtime, edge functions
engine_note: Standard PostgreSQL (heap tables, B-tree indexes) on a dedicated VM per project; the extra services are separate processes talking to it
consistency: Plain Postgres semantics: multi-row transactions, read committed default, serializable option, WAL flushed on commit. Read replicas are asynchronous, so replica reads can be stale.
scaling: Resize the project's compute (bigger instance); add asynchronous read replicas, including in other regions; no built-in write sharding.
licence: Apache License 2.0 for the platform monorepo (Studio, self-hosting); MIT for Auth; PostgreSQL Licence for Supabase's Postgres build
version_note: The platform is a service; v1.26.08 is the latest monthly release of the open-source monorepo used for self-hosting (GitHub releases).
reach: Reach for it when one small team wants Postgres plus login, file uploads, realtime and an instant API without building a backend first.
avoid: Avoid when you need write scale beyond one Postgres primary, or when you would rather own your API layer than expose the database through generated APIs.
escape: Adds auth, storage, realtime, generated APIs and edge functions around a plain Postgres database.
chat: The whole backend of an early chat app: users via Auth, chats and messages in Postgres, realtime for live updates.
notes: Licences read from raw LICENSE files on 2026-10-04: supabase/supabase Apache-2.0, supabase/realtime and supabase/storage Apache-2.0, supabase/auth MIT, supabase/postgres PostgreSQL Licence. Default Postgres major for new projects not confirmed. Read replica asynchrony quoted from the read replicas docs.
